about_the_game:
In the demo version, players can play as Momo and Dodo and experience the first chapter of the story mode.

Players can try out all the basic gameplay features; more interactive scene content will be unlocked in future chapters of the full version.

Currently, the Demo is only available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, and Russian. The full version will support more languages.
